newsitem.title: USA: PathoGenesis finishes Phase III TOBI tests.
newsitem.headline: PathoGenesis finishes Phase III TOBI tests.

text.p: PathoGenesis Corp said Friday it has completed two Phase III clinical trials of its tobramycin for inhalation product, TOBI, for the treatment of chronic lung infections in patients with cystic fibrosis.
PathoGenesis said that 468 patients in 69 cystic fibrosis centers in the U.S. completed the double-blined, placebo-controlled trials.

PathoGenesis expects to be able to announce results of the Phase III trials in the first quarter of 1997 and currently anticipates filing a New Drug Application for TOBI by the end of the second quarter of 1997.

The firm also said that over 80 percent of the patients completing the Phase III studies elected to participate in an open label, follow-on trial study in which all patients will receive TOBI for a six-month period.
